matched: Explored response effects of important effluent variables to operation conditions and influent characteristics in anammox-based nitrogen removal processes via big data analysis and AutoML algorithm
Analysis of big data presented that continuous flow reactors with anammox aggregates could address higher nitrogen loadings in municipal wastewater
High accuracy achieved by AutoML candidate models for important output variables on both literature and unseen experiments
Interpretable analysis of optimal models clarified 1D and 2D response effects between input and output variables
Appropriate ranges of key characteristics identified: C/N, influent NH4+-N, influent TIN, influent COD, HRT, and NLR
Findings deepen understanding and support practical operation of anammox-based processes for treating municipal wastewater
All data supporting findings available in paper and Supplementary Information
